 AI development tools are part of how this team builds: you define what a change needs to do, review what the tools produce, and own the result, whether you wrote the code or a tool did. **LOCATION**
 1150 Atwater Drive, Malvern, PA 19355\. This is a hybrid position and will be required to be in office 3 to 4 days per week.

 The following responsibilities are considered essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.
   

  

**Requirements \& Solution Design**
* Understand what the business is asking for and why, turn it into something the team can build and test, and explain the tradeoffs in plain words to Product Owners and other non\-technical people.
* Partner with Product Owners and stakeholders to clarify requirements, define acceptance criteria, and surface edge cases before development begins.
* Define what each change needs to do, including expected behavior, failure cases, and constraints, before directing AI tools to build it.
* Choose the simplest design that meets the need, placing logic and data in the layer where they belong rather than adding layers by default.
* Break features into small, well\-scoped changes that can be built, reviewed, and tested independently.


**AI\-Assisted Development**
* Use AI development tools, including Cursor or Claude Code, to plan, generate, and refine code across the full application stack.
* Select the right models, prompts, skills, and rules for each task, and improve team practices as the tools evolve.
* Review and iterate on AI\-generated output until it meets requirements, coding standards, and security expectations.
* Own the result of every change, whether you wrote the code or a tool did.


**Quality, Testing \& Review**
* Test failure paths as well as success paths, and provide evidence of results with each change.
* Deploy fixes and features to a development environment to confirm they work beyond localhost.
* Build in logging and error handling so problems are visible, diagnosable, and handled safely.
* Submit changes for review by tools and other developers, and account for downstream effects on other areas of the system.


**Delivery \& Support**
* Complete assigned and committed work, raising interference or slippage early and working with management on a plan.
* Own features from requirements through release and support, including issues that arise after you move on to new work.
* Participate in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives as an active Agile team member.
* Maintain clear technical documentation so other developers can understand, support, and extend your work.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**CORE COMPETENCIES**
 The following competencies represent the professional behaviors and attributes essential to success in this role:
   

  

**Leadership \& Influence**
* Raises engineering standards through thoughtful code reviews, mentoring, and technical example.
* Guides development teams toward shared product goals with confidence and clarity.
* Makes decisive, well\-reasoned prioritization decisions under competing demands.


**Communication \& Collaboration**
* Gives and receives clear, constructive technical feedback without making it personal.
* Communicates clearly and professionally across all levels of the organization, both internally and externally.
* Collaborate effectively with engineering, service, and stakeholder teams to align product direction.


**Problem\-Solving \& Accountability**
* Uses evidence to find root causes and takes steps to prevent recurring issues.
* Develops creative solutions to complex technical and product challenges.
* Takes ownership of product outcomes and holds teams accountable to quality and timelines.


**Organization \& Attention to Detail**
* Anticipates dependencies, edge cases, and downstream effects to prevent issues ahead of time.
* Manages multiple priorities (roadmap, backlog, sprints, and vendor relationships) without sacrificing quality.
* Ensures accuracy and thoroughness in all product documentation and deliverables.


**Professionalism \& Ethics**
* Handles customer data, system access, and intellectual property responsibly.
* Acts with honesty, integrity, and transparency at all times.
* Represents Cenero professionally in all client, partner, and stakeholder interactions.


**Education And Experience**
**Education**
* A Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent professional experience is accepted.


**Experience**
* Typically 2 to 5 years experience building and supporting web applications, or equivalent shipped work. Years convey experience, and are not a fixed requirement.


**Skills And Abilities**
**Technical Skills**
* AI Development: Build and integrate AI\-powered features across the full web stack using APIs, large language models, and agent frameworks, including agents and workflow automation.
* Full\-Stack Development: Read, review, and direct work in React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind, C\#, and .NET, including both .NET Framework and modern .NET \- including code they did not write.

 The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly\-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.
   

  

 Snap Engineering teams build fun and technically sophisticated products that reach hundreds of millions of Snapchatters around the world, every day. We’re deeply committed to the well\-being of everyone in our global community, which is why our values are at the root of everything we do. We move fast, with precision, and always execute with privacy at the forefront.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join Snap Inc. within our Ads Delivery Platform team.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Design, implement, and operate our ads delivery infrastructure and services. Own critical serving\-time systems and business logic that enable reliable, scalable, and efficient ad delivery.
* Partner closely with Product, Data Science, ML, and Infrastructure teams to translate product vision into scalable technical solutions, driving end\-to\-end execution from concept to launch and ongoing optimization.
* Design, test, debug, and maintain high\-quality production systems, leveraging observability, experimentation, and automation to ensure robust and resilient services.
* Champion best practices in distributed systems, availability, scalability, operational excellence, security, and infrastructure efficiency while helping evolve the long\-term architecture of the ads delivery platform.
* Utilize AI tools and high velocity engineering workflows to design and ship scalable services while upholding rigorous standards for code correctness, security, and production ready quality code


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* Experience with backend services or distributed systems
* Experience in at least one of the following areas:
+ Large\-scale microservices and distributed systems
+ Cloud computing and storage systems
+ Infrastructure and large\-scale system design
+ Security
+ Networking and data storage
+ Machine learning and natural language processing
+ Tools

* Proven track record of operating highly\-available systems at significant scale
* Experience with Java, C\+\+, and/or Python
* Experience with NoSQL solutions, Memcache/Redis, Kubernetes, or Google/AWS services
* You can independently execute on medium sized features, taking a few weeks and multiple PRs to complete
* You understand the operational aspects of your system and may participate in incident or hotfix investigation and resolution
* Ability to collaborate and work well with others
* Proficiency in, or a strong aptitude for, leveraging AI tools to streamline development, paired with the critical judgment to audit generated output for architectural integrity, performance bottlenecks, and security risks.
* Adaptability in learning and applying evolving AI systems and tools to remain at the forefront of engineering trends and modern development practices


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree in a relevant technical field such as computer science or equivalent years of practical work experience
* 6\+ years of post\-Bachelor’s software development experience; or Master’s degree in a technical field \+ 5\+ year of post\-grad software development experience; or PhD in a relevant technical field \+ 2\+ years of post\-grad software development experience
* Experience with distributed systems
* Experience with Java, C\+\+, and/or Python


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience building ad delivery, recommendation, marketplace auction, search, retrieval, or other high\-throughput online serving systems.
* Experience supporting multiple product surfaces through shared backend platforms and frameworks.
* Familiarity with ads concepts, including ad serving, targeting, frequency capping, auctions, bidding systems, pacing, or campaign optimization.
* Experience improving system efficiency, infrastructure utilization, and cost\-performance tradeoffs at scale.
* Experience leveraging AI\-assisted development tools and modern engineering workflows to improve engineering productivity and software quality.
